subject: EdgeConf Singapore — clarify demo start time vs hotel local clock
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Megan Lee <megan.lee@fintech.co>, Rui Zhang <rui.zhang@edgeconf.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeConf Singapore — clarify demo start time vs hotel local clock

Hi Megan / Rui —

Thanks again for booking time with us at EdgeConf. Quick clarification request: the conference agenda lists our demo at "10:00" on Oct 30 (SGT). A couple of things we've seen cause confusion at past events and I want to avoid it here: hotel clocks sometimes display a different local offset (phone/carrier vs hotel system), and a few attendees will join remotely from the US where daylight savings is still in effect until early November.

Proposal: lock the demo to 10:00 SGT (Singapore Time, UTC+8) and include explicit conversions in the calendar invite. Example conversions to include in the invite copy:
- 10:00 SGT (UTC+8) — 02:00 UTC on Oct 30
- 19:00 PDT on Oct 29 (US west coast) — note: PDT/PST changes Nov 1

Can you confirm the room location (hotel ballroom vs conference hall)? If the demo is at the hotel, I'll ask Marissa to add a short note to the invite saying "Meet in Grand Marriot Ballroom B — please check hotel lobby clock and follow posted conference schedule (all times SGT)."

I'll attach a one-pager and an .ics with explicit timezone metadata for attendees.

Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: edgeconf-demo-one-pager.pdf, proposed_slots.ics

Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeConf Singapore — clarify demo start time vs hotel local clock

Thanks, Irene — good catch.

We're inside FinTech Co.'s conference logistics team. The official session listing on the EdgeConf site shows 10:00 on Oct 30 (SGT), but a few attendees who are staying at the Grand Marriot reported the lobby clock is set to the hotel's internal system and was showing +30 minutes last night (they thought the talk started earlier).

We'd prefer the demo be anchored explicitly to SGT in the invite and for you to include a note about the room name and a backup plan in case of hotel clock discrepancy.

Two asks from our side:
- Please add a Zoom link for remote attendees (we'll circulate to our US team).
- If possible, include a 15-minute buffer after the demo for quick follow-ups (on the invite).

Happy to confirm the attendee list once the invite looks final.

— Megan
Megan Lee

Thanks for checking — our property management system is set to Singapore Standard Time (UTC+8). We did an update last night which caused a brief display offset on one of the lobby clocks; our engineering team patched it at 00:40 SGT. All ballroom clocks were verified and show the correct time.

Attached: photo of the lobby clock after the patch (hotel-clock-photo.jpg).

Best,

reservations@grandmarriot-sg.com

Notes from my side:
- Hotel confirms ballroom clocks are correct (good) but lobby had a transient offset (they fixed it).
- Suggest we: (1) finalize invite with SGT anchor, (2) include the Zoom link and explicit "times listed in SGT" language, and (3) add a line in the invite: "If you're in the hotel, follow ballroom signage and the conference schedule (all times SGT)."

I'll be on-site that day; happy to help direct folks if anything still looks off.
